# Feature Card

`features/feature-card` &middot; content-level &middot; category: features

## Purpose

One feature: an icon or step number, a title, a short description and an optional link.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feature` | feature |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Centered icon, title and description.
- **left**: Left-aligned. Sets `align: left`.
- **round-icon**: Circular icon crop (square in Outlook desktop). Sets `iconRadius: 50%`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `iconSize` | length | `"48px"` |
| `iconRadius` | length | `"0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text and images honored. Circular crops render square. | Fine. The title carries the meaning if images are blocked. | Text swaps via dm-text where honored. Icons are not recolored. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('features/feature-card', {
  "feature": {
    "icon": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/96x96/png?text=Ship",
      "alt": "Free shipping",
      "decorative": true
    },
    "title": "Free shipping over $75",
    "description": "Delivered in 2 to 4 working days, tracked from door to door.",
    "cta": {
      "label": "See delivery options",
      "href": "https://example.com/pages/shipping"
    }
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "features/feature-card",
  "data": {
    "feature": {
      "icon": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/96x96/png?text=Ship",
        "alt": "Free shipping",
        "decorative": true
      },
      "title": "Free shipping over $75",

      "cta": {
        "label": "See delivery options",
        "href": "https://example.com/pages/shipping"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
